evals.prompt: My microphone sounds noisy on stream and picks up room hum. Clean up my 'Mic/Aux' input in OBS Studio.
evals.expected_output: Verifies input name via get_input_list if unsure, calls clean_audio_input(input_name='Mic/Aux') rather than manually assembling raw filters, and reports created/skipped filter stages (Noise Gate -> Noise Suppression -> Compressor) plus tuning hints.
assertions: Verifies or respects exact case-sensitive input name via get_input_list
Uses composite clean_audio_input instead of manually chaining three raw CreateSourceFilter calls
Notes filter order (Gate -> Suppression -> Compressor) and threshold adjustment guidance

evals.prompt: Why is OBS dropping frames during my recording/stream right now?
evals.expected_output: Calls diagnose_av_health() to gather render skip %, output skip %, congestion, reconnect status, and free recording disk space in one call, and maps findings to GPU/scene, encoder, network bitrate, or storage bottlenecks.
assertions: Calls diagnose_av_health in one shot rather than forcing manual ratio math
Distinguishes render skips vs encoder skips vs network congestion vs low disk space

evals.prompt: Stage the 'Gameplay' scene in Studio Mode preview, check how it looks, and then transition it live.
evals.expected_output: Calls get_scene_list to confirm 'Gameplay', ensures Studio Mode is enabled via get_studio_mode_enabled / set_studio_mode_enabled(True), calls set_current_preview_scene('Gameplay'), optionally captures a screenshot via get_source_screenshot, and calls trigger_studio_mode_transition.
assertions: Checks scene list / Studio Mode state before switching
Does not jump straight to set_current_program_scene when staging in Studio Mode
